note: The React Native runtime adds `useReducedMotion` (from `AccessibilityInfo`), `useWindowWidth`, `useWindowHeight` and the `Sized` wrapper, for `_motionReduce`/`_motionSafe` and viewport lengths. Window changes now notify every hook, and React renders again only the components whose value changed. The runtime grows from 1,185 B to 1,302 B min+gzip.
